commands: Use Xcode-beta package tests and focused iPhone/Watch hosts; inspect actual schemes and destinations before tests; document device-route procedures and actual results separately.
externalEffects: No external service or remote mutation. Any audio-session category, route behavior, and background capability change requires explicit scope confirmation and physical-device evidence.
fileChanges: Add platform session/lifecycle adapters, focused tests, host integration tests, and route/evidence documentation only during authorized implementation.
notes: PLAN-005 is planning only; it does not activate SP-006 or authorize implementation.
scope: iPhone and Watch session adapters around the qualified shared renderer; lifecycle state model and tests; no microphone, profiles, synchronization, user authoring, network, accounts, analytics, or unapproved background entitlement.
summary: Plan minimal iPhone and Watch audio-session ownership, deterministic playback lifecycle transitions, route/error handling, and separated simulator versus physical-device evidence.
title: SP-006 Session and Playback Lifecycle Plan
verificationCriteria: Automate state transitions and failure paths where platform simulation is meaningful; leave listening, route, Silent Mode, lock/background, energy, thermal, Bluetooth, and media-control evidence explicitly pending until physically tested.
